notes:
Account: ConvoScale (multi-tenant agent platform for SMBs and mid-market). Primary product: hosted chat agents with tool integrations (search, CRM writes, payments).

Current motion: evaluating Hosted API for quick POC (streaming + tool-calling). If POC meets latency & stability SLOs they'll move to Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable tail latencies and tenant isolation.

Requirements summary (from product + infra):
- Workload: chat/agent workflows with streaming responses and outward tool calls (webhooks) per turn
- Latency SLO: 90-150ms per-token on average; 95th perc target < 300ms for interactive flows
- Throughput: steady-state ~20 RPS per high-tier tenant, ~200 active tenants in peak; spikes up to 800 concurrent streams across customers
- Multi-tenant controls: per-tenant quotas/ratelimits, burst protection, per-tenant usage tagging for billing
- Stability: streaming stability under bursts is highest priority (partial streams previously observed in internal tests)
- Security: SOC2, SSO/SAML, audit logs, option for EU data residency for select customers
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; will evaluate hosted pricing for POC but prefer Dedicated unit economics for scale

Quotes / call snippets:
- "If streaming drops or delays, our UX collapses — need stable tail latency." — VP Product
- "We need per-tenant rate-limits and clear billing tags; can't have noisy neighbors impacting customers." — Head of Platform

POC scope agreed:
- 2-week sandbox on Hosted API with streaming + tool-call test harness
- Load tests to simulate 800 concurrent streams, tenant-level quota enforcement tests, and latency SLAs measurement
- SE to instrument tracing and share per-route latency breakdowns via Redwood Console demo

Open items: Dedicated pricing tiers, SLA/uptime terms for Dedicated, implementation pattern for tenant-level quotas and billing tags, EU residency options and timeline.
